title: Market Research Analyst
description: A pharmaceutical company seeks a Market Research Analyst to support its oncology franchise. You will analyze patient and prescriber data, track therapeutic launches, and brief commercial teams on biotech market trends. Familiarity with the drug development lifecycle and payer dynamics is a plus. You will work in Excel and Tableau.
